newsitem.title: CHINA: HK 28-day average accepted yield 5.93 percent. [CORRECTED 9:37 GMT]
newsitem.headline: HK 28-day average accepted yield 5.93 percent. [CORRECTED 9:37 GMT]

text.p: The average accepted yield of 28-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.93 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with an average accepted yield of 5.60 percent at the last tender and one-month HIBOR of 6.2500 percent at 0300 GMT.
Bids for the HK$5.0 billion issue were HK$13.46 billion compared with HK$14.48 billion at the last tender.

The average accepted yield for 91-day Exchange Fund bills tendered on Tuesday was 5.88 percent (corrects from "5.93 percent") compared to 5.58 percent at the last tender and three-month HIBOR of 6.41667 percent at 0300 GMT.
Bids for the HK$2.0 billion issue were HK$5.660 billion compared to HK$8.17 billion at the last tender.

The average accepted yield for 182-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.94 percent (corrects from "5.98 percent") against 5.80 percent at the last tender and six-month HIBOR of 6.58333 percent.
Bids for the HK$1.0 billion issue were HK$3.31 billion compared to HK$3.06 billion at the last tender.
